entries.title: One card about a finished task, and a finished answer is no longer called dropped
entries.body: After you close a crewmate's card about finished work, your first mate no longer adds a second note saying the task merged, was released or was dropped. A finished investigation whose answer your first mate passed on now closes as answered, where it was announced as dropped.
entries.noPicture: The change is a card that no longer appears and a task that closes with a different word, so there is nothing new to see.
